scripts.test:ci-projects: node --test scripts/ci-projects.test.mjs scripts/cli-nightly-version.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-deployment.test.mjs scripts/deploy-workflow.test.mjs scripts/migrate-cloudflare-token.test.mjs scripts/oxc-config.test.mjs
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter '@sentry/mcp-cloudflare...' --if-present run build && dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- pnpm --parallel --filter @sentry/mcp-cloudflare --filter @sentry/mcp-core --filter @sentry/mcp-server-mocks --if-present run dev
scripts.dev:stdio: pnpm --filter '@sentry/mcp-server...' --if-present run build && dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- pnpm --parallel --filter @sentry/mcp-server --filter @sentry/mcp-core --filter @sentry/mcp-server-mocks --if-present run dev
scripts.build:cli: dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- pnpm --filter sentry run build && pnpm --filter sentry-cli-docs run build
scripts.deploy:docs: pnpm --filter sentry run generate:schema && pnpm --filter sentry run generate:docs && pnpm --filter sentry-cli-docs run build && pnpm --filter sentry-cli-docs run deploy
scripts.eval: pnpm --filter '@sentry/mcp-server-evals...' --if-present run build && dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- pnpm --filter @sentry/mcp-server-evals run eval
scripts.eval:ci: pnpm --filter '@sentry/mcp-server-evals...' --if-present run build && CI=true dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- pnpm --stream -r run eval:ci
scripts.test: pnpm run build && dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- pnpm -r --filter '!@sentry/mcp-smoke-tests' --if-present run test
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run build && CI=true dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- pnpm --stream -r run test:ci
scripts.tsc: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --if-present run tsc && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: pnpm run pre-commit:generated && pnpm exec lint-staged --concurrent false
